data_integrity_notes.zero_fabrication_rule: Prices are derived strictly from official APMC market records. Synthetic ±5% bands and hardcoded price floors have been eliminated.
data_integrity_notes.continuous_grid_caveat: Daily continuous date indexing includes market non-trading days where prices reflect previous market close forward-fills rather than independent market auctions.
data_integrity_notes.state_filtering: State models are evaluated strictly on observations within each canonical state identifier.

outlier_investigation_and_correction.root_cause: Clerical data entry error where total daily market auction turnover (₹1.207 Crore across 76 reporting mandis) was recorded in the rate per quintal field instead of modal rate.
outlier_investigation_and_correction.evidence: Adjacent observation dates: 2024-12-22 modal price was ₹1,981.20 (min ₹1,146.59, max ₹2,659.30) and 2024-12-24 modal price was ₹1,737.46 (min ₹952.27, max ₹2,377.93). National modal price was ₹3,997.17. Reported spread (max - min = ₹1,566.41) matched normal trading spreads.
outlier_investigation_and_correction.impact: This single row contributed (1.207e7)^2 / 27564 = 5.288e9 to MSE, inflating Onion RMSE to ₹72,722.51. When corrected to the median rate of adjacent dates (₹1,859.33), Onion RMSE drops to ₹520.82 and MAE drops to ₹278.94 (Maharashtra state RMSE drops to ₹307.74).
